title: MEATER Stall Phase Over Two Hours
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=meater:cook
| stats max(stall_minutes) as stall_minutes by cook_id protein
| where stall_minutes>120
| sort - stall_minutes
description: Uses MEATER cook sessions telemetry to monitor how long proteins stay in the stall phase in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for cooks that need earlier start times or wrap strategy, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest MEATER cook sessions data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how long proteins stay in the stall phase so you can spot cooks that need earlier start times or wrap strategy before it becomes annoying.
